name: Fly Fishing
overview: Fly-fishing is a specialized form of fishing that combines skill and artistry. Because it is so rich with tradition, it is a passion for millions of people. The beauty of the water, the solitude, and the skills that the sport requires have made fly-fishing very important in the lives of many notable people.

content.value: Do the following:

sub_requirements.label: a
sub_requirements.text: Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in fly-fishing activities and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. Name and explain five safety practices you should always follow while fly-fishing.

content.value: Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in fly-fishing activities and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. resources.title: Why Is Fishing Dangerous? Don't Overlook These Risks! (website)

sub_requirements.label: b
sub_requirements.text: Discuss the prevention of and treatment for the following health concerns that could occur while fly-fishing: cuts and scratches, puncture wounds, insect bites, hypothermia, dehydration, heat exhaustion, heatstroke, and sunburn.

requirements.text: Demonstrate how to tie proper knots to prepare a fly rod for fishing:

content.value: Demonstrate how to tie proper knots to prepare a fly rod for fishing:

sub_requirements.label: a
sub_requirements.text: Tie backing to the arbor of a fly reel spool using an arbor knot.

content.value: Tie backing to the arbor of a fly reel spool using an arbor knot.

sub_requirements.label: b
sub_requirements.text: Tie backing to the fly line using a nail (tube) knot.

content.value: Tie backing to the fly line using a nail (tube) knot.

sub_requirements.label: c
sub_requirements.text: Attach a leader to the fly line using a nail (tube) knot or a loop-to-loop connection.

sub_requirements.label: d
sub_requirements.text: Add a tippet to a leader using a surgeon's knot or a loop-to-loop connection.

content.value: Add a tippet to a leader using a surgeon's knot or a loop-to-loop connection.

sub_requirements.text: Tie a fly onto the terminal end of the leader using an improved clinch knot.

requirements.text: Explain how and when each of the following types of flies is used: dry flies, wet flies, nymphs, streamers, bass bugs, poppers, and saltwater flies. Tell what each one imitates. Tie at least two types of the flies mentioned in this requirement.
